canonicalCards.directCandidateAnswer: The goal is musical coherence, not maximum visual alignment. Stop when the distraction disappears in context and further movement reduces groove, expression, articulation, or tone. The main risk is: Continuing after the problem disappears can create robotic timing and stretch artifacts.

canonicalCards.title: Knowing When Timing Is Tight Enough — tradeoff
tradeoffs: The edit can improve the performance feeling intentional, connected, and natural rather than merely grid-aligned, but Continuing after the problem disappears can create robotic timing and stretch artifacts.
